subject: AislePay CSA response and artifact routing
messages:
From: Tom Brewer <tom.brewer@aislepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AislePay Security <security@aislepay.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CSA/CAIQ - initial ask and timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for agreeing to work through AislePay's CSA/CAIQ requests. Attached is our CAIQ spreadsheet with a couple of clarifying columns for artifacts we need (evidence type + person of contact). We ran our initial scan and flagged ~18 high-priority controls we'd like annotated for our procurement review.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can provide a completed CAIQ (answer + rationale + link to artifact) by Aug 26 for the prioritized list
- A single point-of-contact for artifact delivery and who owns sub-controls for runtime controls (session management, key rotation, telemetry)

We prefer Drive links to artifacts and examples of logs where possible.

Attachments: AP-CAIQ-ask-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Tom Brewer\Security & Compliance\AislePay
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Brewer <tom.brewer@aislepay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ - initial ask and timeline

Tom — thanks for the note and the template. Happy to own the response coordination.

Quick plan:
- We will take the prioritized 18 rows and produce answers + short rationale + one artifact link per control by EOD Aug 26 (target).
- Internal assignment: Kimberly will lead collection for infra/network artifacts; David will pull telemetry and access logs; I'll assemble the spreadsheet and do policy-level rationales.
- Please confirm if redaction of IPs is required for log samples; we can provide both redacted and an on-call window if you need raw samples.

CC: Kimberly/David — please see Tom's attached template. I'll start an internal artifact bucket and share a Drive folder by EOD today.

Attachments in this thread: AP-CAIQ-ask-template.xlsx (from AislePay)

Thanks,
Soojin Lee\Senior Security Program Manager\Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-21T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: CSA/CAIQ - initial ask and timeline

Marissa, forwarding AislePay's ask — Kimberly here.

Please take ownership of the following subcontrols from the prioritized list:
- CCM-06 (Network segmentation / firewall configs)
- CCM-08 (Perimeter monitoring - IDS/IPS ruleset snapshots)
- CCM-09 (Flow capture and packet-level diagrams for scope systems)

Deliverables expected:
- infra-network-diagram.pdf (annotated)
- snippets of firewall ACLs (redacted)
- short note on our segmentation approach (1-2 paragraphs)

Deadline: Aug 25 COB so Soojin can assemble responses on Aug 26.

On Fri, Aug 20, 2027 at 11:05 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tom — thanks for the note and the template. Happy to own the response coordination.
> 
> Quick plan:...

Thanks,
Kimberly\Lead Cloud Security Engineer\Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CSA/CAIQ - initial ask and timeline

Thanks Kim — I have started the artifact pack for the three infra items. Planned steps:
1) Pull latest infra network diagram and annotate scope boundaries (will deliver infra-network-diagram.pdf).
2) Export firewall ACL snippets and redact CIDR ranges and internal hostnames.
3) Package packet capture samples from the 72-hour review window (redacted) — will provide as a zipped sample if needed.

I'll place everything in the Drive folder once ready and link to the CAIQ spreadsheet under the "Artifacts" column. Expect first drop tomorrow morning (Aug 23).

Also, quick question for Soojin: for CCM-08 IDS ruleset, do you want our ruleset config or a high-level detection mapping? We can do both but that'll add time.

Attachments (incoming): none yet — generating artifacts now.

—Marissa\Security Operations\Redwood Inference
From: Tom Brewer <tom.brewer@aislepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: AislePay Security <security@aislepay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ - initial ask and timeline

This looks great — appreciate the rapid turnaround. A couple quick notes:
- Redaction is fine; please provide at least one example with raw tokens behind an NDA if possible (we can escalate).
- For IDS ruleset, high-level mapping is acceptable for procurement; if you can offer a ruleset export under NDA that would be ideal.

Can you share the Drive link when you have the folder? We will validate the matrix and then issue a follow-up for any residual clarifications.

Attachments referenced: AP-CAIQ-ask-template.xlsx (provided earlier)

Tom Brewer\Security & Compliance\AislePay
